items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected/OUT; Travis Etienne did not dominate usage: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson, routes 24/5/7, opps 18/9/4. Surprised by committee.
items.why: ETR weekend report not expected; Levitan post-game snap/route data.
items.implication: Etienne lead but not full dominate; Miller viable handcuff/committee piece; reverse if Kamara returns.
items.opportunity: Etienne  lead snaps/routes/opps but shared; Kamara absence expands both.

items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since 9/28/25 ACL+meniscus: 36-of-69 snaps (52%), 24-of-34 routes (71%), 9 targets for team-high 31% share, 6-69-0, emerged healthy.
items.why: Late decision ~2hrs pre-kick; family didn't travel due to uncertainty; full healthy post-game feel.
items.implication: Start confidently ROS; high target share immediately despite limited snaps; decoy risk low given volume.
items.opportunity: 71% routes, 31% target share on limited snaps signals WR1 role when fully ramped.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming; would have returned if playoff game. Coach confirms D2D good sign.
items.why: Sources + coach Jesse Minter; not considered serious.
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely play Week 2 or close; limited absence expected.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE (ankle); risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere—wouldn't activate if major worry (Cardinals caveat). ETR expected to play.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor post-game role vs Allgeier.
items.opportunity: Rookie lead potential if healthy snaps expand.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN underway. Buy low on Colston Loveland (preseason wanted Bears offense pieces; Week 1 weirdness not panic). Concern Etienne/LAC/London-Pitts/Fannin; time now for Watson/Monty/Coke Heads.
items.why: FF Happy Hour Week 1 reaction; Likely production + Loveland buy window.
items.implication: Start/add Likely; hold/buy Loveland; fade or bench concerns short-term.

items.text: Ladd McConkey rib/chest injury: undergoing further testing (X-ray/MRI) to determine severity; may miss time.
items.why: Hard hit over middle; finished 5-82-1 before exit.
items.implication: Monitor midweek; if out, slot work to others in LAC; hold for now.

items.text: Start Malik Nabers wherever owned post-active (risk/reward decoy possible but play him).
items.why: Active decision + volume potential outweighs decoy risk.
items.implication: Must-start WR after healthy return showing.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane fractured wrist, ruled out, expected miss several weeks; further testing/MRI.
items.implication: Drop or stash deep; opens snaps for other Ravens WRs behind Flowers.

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks, placed on IR.
items.implication: Stash if IR spot; handcuff/look for NE WR streamers or diggs/mclaurin boosts long-term.

items.text: After meniscus trim Tuesday, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers; see how he feels this week.
items.implication: Hold/start if cleared; TE premium upside intact for ROS.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY then officially ACTIVE.
items.why: Weekend report expected; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Start in Bears high-powered offense; no lingering concern.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. has zero career games with 8+ catches. Kendrick Bourne ARZ debut age 31: 8-75-0.
items.why: Career volume fact + Week 1 observation (Bourne outproduced).
items.implication: Temper expectations on boom games; still WR starter but efficiency/volume questions.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally over PCL: 42-of-57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside unlocked; start confidently ROS.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks worked side early week (groin tweak alleged).
items.implication: Hubbard preferred short-term; Brooks handcuff with upside if healthy full.
items.opportunity: Clear Hubbard lead in snaps/routes; Brooks limited opps.
